summary: performance lens over assistant-bounded-generation (16 product path(s), f7c9949..302173a, Codex via the autoreview skill at --max-priority P2): 1 blocking, 1 non-blocking. The core bounded-generation, retry, usage accounting, ingress limits, and cancellation wiring are present, but the patch will fail the established D-0006 quality gate because it edits an ignored controller without updating the baseline. Its 4096-token retry also retains a concrete long-latency path despite the measurements motivating this change.

non_blocking_findings.summary: [P2] Do not raise the retry generation cap to 4096 tokens (backend/src/llm/llm.constants.ts:5): Every tool-less first response invokes a second selector request with a 4096-token cap.
